We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

The Sales Strategy teams define sales approaches for all products in our portfolio. They provide sales feedback to the product teams to guide product development and enablement material development and identify inventive ways to teach sellers how to sell. Motorola Solutions provides critical public safety solutions for our customers with offerings from our Services and Cybersecurity Portfolio, including managed and support services, professional services, lifecycle services, and cybersecurity solutions. A key function within the North America (NA) Sales Operations team is that of a Portfolio Strategist lead for the services and cybersecurity portfolio. In addition, this function leads readiness efforts to enable direct, channel and inside sales teams to understand key value propositions, solution features from customer perspective and differentiators over competition.

• Build practical, bite-sized selling tools (e.g., SPIN questions, ROM quote guidance, ecosystem integration strategies) to empower field sellers across all phases of sales enablement

• Reducing friction points for the sales organization with new product and solution launches

• Evaluation of interactions and interfaces of solutions that stretch beyond the assigned portfolio

• Ability to change presentation styles as needed, ex. technical presale vs. senior leadership

• Identification of best routes to market and strategies that will increase sales

• Guide offer teams on the strategy to increase ecosystem sales and reduce seller friction to extend proposals from product siloes

title: Applied Research Scientist, World Model
description:
About the team
Zillow has the richest housing market data in the industry. You help us build out a foundational model that leverages a representation of who is in the market, what they’ll pay, and how that demand clears against supply.

The Agentic Foundations team is a focused group of 15-20 applied scientists within Zillow’s broader Agentic AI organization, building the foundational AI technologies that power the next generation of home shopping experiences. This Principal Applied Scientist will help build the Zillow World Model: a single, uncertainty-aware model of the housing market that ties together supply, demand and macro conditions such as mortgage rates and policy. Today, bespoke models like Zestimate, Time-to-Pending and Listing Soon each answer one question well. The foundational “World” Model aims to answer the multi-step “what if” questions consumers actually ask, such as “If I list at $500K, when will it sell?” or “I want at least $800K; what should I list at?”, as consistent projections of one market state, and to serve those answers to Voyager, Zillow’s AI Mode, as a tool.

This is a very new field and an open-ended research effort. You will partner with the World Model working group (listing-state modeling, market simulation and evaluation) and with product, engineering, platform and data teams. Zillow observes both sides of the housing market at a depth no one else can, so this work can directly help guide users toward their goals. About the role

• Build the demand layer of the World Model: turn large-scale shopper behavior (search, engagement, session trajectories) into structured demand representations, including explicit attention-to-demand conversion.

• Design and train latent state-space, multi-tower and/or sequential dynamics models with calibrated uncertainty that support multi-step rollouts, forward planning (“if I do X, what happens?”) and backward planning (“I want X; what should I do?”).

• Estimate willingness-to-pay, per-home demand curves and market clearing dynamics, connecting learned representations to economic quantities.

• Apply causal identification in observational data and define where the model must abstain because a correlation does not support a “what-if” claim.

• Contribute to the World Model evaluation battery: state probes, calibrated multi-target forecasts, rollout drift, causal checks and out-of-regime replays.

• Independently drive ambiguous research end-to-end, and provide technical leadership and mentorship in translating state-of-the-art research into production impact.

• Escalate emergencies, delays, service problems, and approval issues

• Coordinate estimates and confirm that required approvals are received before work begins

• Collect completion notes, photos, invoices, and other supporting documentation

• Consistent follow through without needing repeated reminders

• Ability to work remotely with reliable internet and a quiet place for client calls

• Ability to participate in scheduled after hours coverage

The AI Governance Analyst is central to building and operating AlphaSense’s AI governance program, helping ensure that the way we deploy, build, and procure AI systems is well-governed, well-documented, and defensible to regulators, auditors, and enterprise clients. Sitting within the Strategic Risk team, this role owns the day-to-day execution of AI risk assessments - intake, classification, evaluation, and documentation - that keep the program running at scale.

As AlphaSense matures its governance infrastructure, including the rollout of a dedicated GRC platform to automate assessment workflows, this role acts as the operational backbone of the program: turning frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001 into repeatable, auditable processes that grow with the business. This is a risk and governance role - not a hands-on AI engineering role - well-suited to someone who understands how AI systems create risk and knows how to manage it.

What You’ll Do:

• Complete AI risk assessments using established templates and criteria - gathering details on AI use cases, working through classification and control questions, and preparing draft assessments for senior review.

• Maintain the accuracy of the AI system inventory by adding and updating records of AI/ML systems, vendors, and use cases.

• Leverage the AI governance platform to enter assessment data, follow set workflows, and organize supporting evidence and documentation.

• Gather the information and evidence needed to map use cases against frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001, with guidance on interpretation from senior team members.

• Coordinate with engineering, product, security, legal and privacy, and procurement contacts to collect the details needed for assessments, and flag open questions for review.

• Assist with third-party and vendor AI risk reviews by collecting vendor documentation and completing initial reviews for senior validation.

• Draft clear, well-organized summaries and notes from completed assessments, and flag higher-risk or unclear items to senior reviewers.

• Track the status of assessments and follow-ups, keeping records and trackers up to date so nothing slips through.

Who You Are:

• IAPP AIGP certified with a strong knowledge of the AI governance landscape and the major frameworks shaping it.

• 2-4 years of experience in risk management, GRC, compliance, audit, or data privacy, with exposure to AI governance, technology risk, or third-party risk.

• You do it yourself where tools, rights and quality allow it: cut a video, write an article, pull a language version, set up a format. Script, story and format originate with you, not with the vendor.

• You steer by the numbers that matter (reach and trend, watch time, returning viewers, output per asset, content-to-signup signals), plan tests for hooks, thumbnails, titles and formats and bring the learnings to Campaign, Social Media and PR.

• You build and run your own workflows and agents for recurring tasks: derivatives, localisation, versioning, reporting.

• You set the guardrails together with Legal and Design (brand compliance, usage rights, AI content disclosure) and decide which new tools go into the standard process.

• You understand the logic of Campaign, Social Media, PR and Online Marketing: campaign cycles, platform formats, earned media, search. Several brands or markets in parallel, podcast production and DAM systems are welcome.

• Fluent German and English.
